t: Decoding Cursor AI's Terminal: A NixOS User's Deep Dive into Agent Mode
s: Cursor AI's integrated terminal on NixOS operates in a specialized, isolated environment (fhsenv, APPDIR) due to Nix packaging, limiting visibility of certain system paths and prioritizing bundled tools. Understanding this isolation is key to effective use and configuration via Cursor's 'Rules'.
sub: System path vs. application path management
